text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
About ten minutes after wrapping up training
with Jungle Pocket,
I return to the Trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yo!
Took ya long enough!

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Crew
text_block_list.text:
Sup. Thanks for havin' us.
Good work today, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
We all decided to watch some comedy specials
together!
Mind if we use this room?
Couldn't find anywhere else that worked.
choice_data_list: Well, if that's all it's, I suppose...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heh, that's my partner for ya!
Alright,
let's start with "God of Laughter"!

text_block_list.name: Slicked-Back Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! No way... haha!
Isn't this comedian way too funny?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Right?! This guy's unreal!
I'm totally hooked on him!
His solo live show had some crazy,
edgy material too—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Distracted by Jungle Pocket and her friends'
booming laughter,
my hands freeze over the keyboard.
...At this rate,
I can't focus on my work at all.
choice_data_list: ...Um, Pocket? Do you have a second?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Hm? What's up,
Trainer? Wanna watch with us?
choice_data_list: I'm having a hard time getting any...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Truth is,
I have materials that must be compiled by
the end of today.
When I explain this and ask if I can have
some quiet to concentrate—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You gotta concentrate?
What the... Why didn't you—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Say so sooner?! —Hey, listen up, guys!
We're gonna help 'em finish their work!!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Don't be shy! We're partners, aren't we?
When you're in a pinch,
you lean on each other!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Right, guys? You're helping out too,
of course.
Nobody's got a problem with that,
do they?!

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Crew
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, of course we're down!
If it's an order from the Head,
count us in!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...To be completely honest,
all I needed was for them to leave the
room,
but the atmosphere made that impossible to
say out loud.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's split up the tasks!
You two,
gather up all the data on Tokyo
Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You're researching the horsegirls running
against me next... right?
...Ah,
ask the Trainer for the nitty-gritty
details!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Look at this!
Can you use this?!
See, I'm pullin' my weight! ...Hm?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Oi. What do you think you're doing?

text_block_list.name: Slicked-Back Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Ah... S-Sorry, Pocket-san!
I didn't really get how to look up the
data...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
So you played games instead? Huh?!
Is that the best excuse you've got?

text_block_list.name: Slicked-Back Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Ah... ugh... S-Sorry...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Don't go lettin' me down. Got it?
...GOT IT?!

text_block_list.name: Slicked-Back Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, ma'am! I'm so sorry!
Just watch me from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Good.
Heh, as long as you understand!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
And that goes for the rest of you too!
Don't even think about slackin' off!

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Crew
text_block_list.text:
Yes, boss!
Right away, boss!!
choice_data_list: She really is a former gang leader...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Well, deep down they're good kids,
honestly!
Alright, let's wrap this up quick!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to everyone's help,
the data collection progressed smoothly—
and I managed to finish the work in time.
choice_data_list: Thank you! It's all thanks to you ...

text_block_list.name: Cornrow Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Lucky you,
gettin' bailed out by the Head.
You better thank Pocket-san, alright?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, what're you talkin' about?
I ain't their Head. I'm their partner.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Right, partner?
If you ever need a hand again,
just say the word!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nodding in reply,
I silently resolve to become
an adult truly worthy of being her
"partner."
